phantaskippy:

I think the 7 promos include the Sentinels, which would be worth 4 cards, and would put the number much more in line with other promo cards. Also it is 7 promo cards, so any villains are either oversized (likely) or they count as 2 cards.

For heroes we need 13 cards.

Chrono

Guise

Naturalist

Omnitron X

Parse

Scholar

Sentinels [4]

Sky-Scraper [3]

Obviously they could make it work with different card totals for Sentinels and Sky-Scraper, but the chaos of the deck would likely ruin the promo.

 

The Sentinels promo could be a Voltron-like combination of The Sentinels with 4 different powers.

 

"Until the end of your next turn, your character card is also named Dr Medico. Discard a card. If playing the card would heal, deal that much energy damage to that many targets."

" Until the end of your next turn, your character card is also named Mainstay. Reduce damage dealt to 1 target by 1 until the start of your next turn."

" Until the end of your next turn, your character card is also named The Idealist. One player may draw a card."

" Until the end of your next turn, your character card is also named Writhe. You may play a card."

 

It might still need the setup card to fit the powers. The first one is to ensure that the resurrection cards can be used for something. It might take away the appeal of The Sentinels, they won't be a hero team anymore.

posts.cooked:
I figure I might as well add my two cents.

The Masked lady on the box of For Profit is in the slaughterhouse six and Tachyon punches her in the face at some point.

Based on the similarities between the costumes of the masked woman on the For Profit box, the woman in this picture https://twitter.com/GtGAdam/status/560457453608132608, and the mirror lady Tachyon punches in the face on nimble strike, as well as the fact that zooming in on her in the slaughterhouse six picture reveals her own reflection several times, I think it's a safe bet that all of these pictures depict the same person and that she (Aislin is her real name according to Adam) does something cool with mirrors (maybe with that sphere thing she's holding?). I think she'll probably be a mini-nemesis in Ambuscade's deck in VotM and a playable hero/villain for hire in For Profit.

The Hippo is a cyborg now? Maybe?

Hippo's suit on For Profit looks a lot more mechanical and his eyes seem to be much more glowy and red than they were before. Red glowy eyes generally mean one of three things in comics: 1.) The thing with red glowy eyes is an evil but fantastical or magical creature like a demon or vampire, 2.) The thing with red glowy eyes is an evil (or at least morally ambiguous) robotic thingy, or 3.) The red glowy eyes have no signifigance beyond showing extreme rage, anger, or paranoia. It seems possible the Hippo may be a robotic thingy, but his face looks rather human. So what's up with his eyes?

Aminia got burned?

So, that terracotta mask on Amina's face seems to be covering some pretty extensive scarring. If you look closely at this picture (https://twitter.com/GtGAdam/status/557931320014544896) there seems to be small scarring on her neck and next to her eye. What caused the scarring though? Being burned by Ra? A flow of corrosive chemicals hitting her in the face after a well placed arrow pierced a chemical vat? Something else? Also I can't help but notice Aminia lifting an entire bus and most of a sidewalk with her mind. That's new.

The Revenge of the Mini-Nemises?

If I'm right about Aislin, then every confirmed character that we know in For Profit has been or will be a mini-nemesis except the girl lying on the pile of money on the front of the box (I believe Christopher confirmed Heartbreaker would be one somewhere). Is For Profit their revenge for having moderately low threat value in SotM? Does this mean Becky (https://twitter.com/GtGAdam/status/557563818130563072) is going to be a mini-nemesis in VotM? Thoughts?

Environments?

I'm decently sure that Revocorp has something to do with all of these villains that have come together for seemingly no reason. Maybe we'll finally see a Revocorp based environment?

Well, this is everything I could think up for right now. What do you guys think?

Don't know if any of this is new news, but the latest update on the Tactics kickstarter has the following, most of which was new to me at least...

> Sentinel Tactics: Battle for Broken City is the second core game for Sentinel Tactics. The ruined wasteland that was Rook City has gotten even worse, now that Exemplar has begun his chaotic reign. His genetic-abhoration goon-squad of Demon Fist, Grudge, MindPhyre, Karnal, and Cyst patrol the wreckage, seeking to draw life from any they find. Fortunately, the hero team Dark Watch protects the remaining refugees who are stuck in Broken City. Unfortunately, they seem to be thoroughly outmatched.

Sentinel Tactics: Battle for Broken City includes twelve characters, three scenario books, and two map locations. More information on those characters, scenarios, and maps will be revealed over the course of this preorder campaign!

Preorder Bonus: Every copy of Sentinel Tactics: Battle for Broken City ordered during this preorder campaign comes with three art prints and a pack of eighteen promo cards: one additional Power Card for each character from the Battle for Broken City core game AND the For Profit expansion!

Sentinel Tactics: For Profit is the second expansion for Sentinel Tactics. Life has been good for the ragtag team known as "For Profit". They have been working some good jobs - gigs that pay well for minimal effort. Robbed a few banks, museums, and even stole a luxury yacht! However, now they've been contacted by a new client who wants significantly more dangerous work from them... but is offering a LOT more money! And money talks, especially when you're dealing with For Profit.

Sentinel Tactics: For Profit includes six characters and a scenario book with multiple scenarios. More information on those characters and scenarios will be revealed over the course of this preorder campaign!  This product is an expansion, and requires a core Sentinel Tactics game to play.

Preorder Bonus: Every copy of Sentinel Tactics: For Profit ordered during this preorder campaign comes with two bonus alternate Character Panels! Stay tuned for more information on those bonus Character Panels!
